data.name: Hemanga
data.gender_notes: Hemanga is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from two words Hem (Gold) and Ang (Body), Hemanga signifies a golden body. The name Hemanga carries the meaning “Golden Body” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hemanga usually hope their child will grow to embody golden body and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine light and spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Hemanga belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden Body.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemanga total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hemanga has its roots in ancient Sanskrit language and is considered a unique and beautiful name in Hindu culture. It evokes images of wealth, prosperity, and radiance. The word 'gold' in the name signifies richness and prosperity, while the word 'body' signifies the physical form of an individual. This name is often given to children born into well-to-do families, as a reminder of the wealth and prosperity they are born into.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hemanga represents the inner gold or the divine consciousness that resides in every individual. It is a reminder that we are all inherently precious and valuable, and that we have the power to transform ourselves into our highest potential. The name also signifies the union of the physical body and the divine consciousness within us. Therefore, Hemanga is not just a beautiful name, but a constant reminder of the divine essence that exists within each one of us.
